requests.outcome: Official GIS page was identified by first-party discovery as the municipal entry point for the public map viewer and GIS data products; direct curl retrieval timed out after 30 seconds in this run, so page content was not treated as a direct request success.

HTTP 200; official ArcGIS MapServer metadata retrieved. It identifies parcel layer 0, public query formats including GeoJSON, service extent, max record count 1000, and source spatial reference WKID 102738/latestWkid 2276.

HTTP 200; parcel Feature Layer metadata retrieved. Geometry is polygon; fields include safe native PID and OBJECTID plus unsafe owner/address/value fields. Only PID was selected for the sample; unsafe fields were not requested.

HTTP 200 GeoJSON; bounded envelope around exact WUP point [33.0242104850204, -97.0246110353803] returned zero features. This is recorded as an exact-point/local extent miss only, not citywide absence; the coordinate was not shifted.

HTTP 200 GeoJSON; separate bounded in-service envelope returned three full polygon features with native PID values R205717, R205718, and R205719. Response included exceededTransferLimit=true, but all three retained features were complete polygons and the request was capped at three records.
HTTP 200; second official parcel layer metadata retrieved. It documents PID, Denton PID, and subdivision-related fields, but no sample was taken from this duplicate/alternate layer.
